content: An accessory in legal terms refers to an individual who aids or assists a criminal in committing a crime but is not physically present at the scene of the crime. Accessory is also the name of a musical band consisting of members Dirk Steyer and Ivo Lottig. A fashion accessory is an item specifically designed to enhance or complement a particular fashion style or outfit. A video game accessory refers to a piece of hardware or equipment that is utilized to enhance or facilitate the playing of video games. In the field of anatomy, the accessory nucleus is a cranial nerve nucleus associated with specific neural functions. The accessory nerve, also known as cranial nerve XI, is a motor nerve that innervates certain muscles, including the sternocleidomastoid and trapezius muscles. An accessory suite is a secondary residential unit or dwelling located on the same parcel of land as a primary residence.
